newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN still a Merrill buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN still a Merrill buy.

text.p: Merrill Lynch on Tuesday said it had reiterated its buy rating on Brazilian private steelmaker CSN.
-- also said it had raised its 1997 net income projections to 351.7 million reais from 290.2 million reais, and its 1998 net profit estimates to 391.3 million reais from 329.8 million reais.
-- The report followed the company's second quarter results, which Merrill Lynch considered as positive.
-- CSN reported net earnings of 100.2 million reais in the second quarter of 1997.

-- "However, stripping out the 22.7 million reais tax credit and the 12.5 million reais equity contribution from CSN's new holdings, we arrive at an adjusted net income from operations of 65 million reais, which is very much in line with our 63.6 million reais projection," it said.
-- CSN shares were up 0.12 percent at 34.65 reais in late afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
